Data Validation Results Class

Source: R/data_provider.R
DataValidation.Rd

Contains validation results for fetched data

Usage

DataValidation(
  is_valid = logical(0),
  quality_score = integer(0),
  anomalies = list(),
  warnings = character(0),
  errors = character(0)
)

Arguments

is_valid

Logical indicating if data is valid

quality_score

Numeric quality score (0-1)

anomalies

List of detected anomalies

warnings

Character vector of warnings

errors

Character vector of errors
